source_review: The actual copied invert loop, trial construction, objective, halving and gate are retained. Only fixture opener, gate wrapper and solve-return call sites are redirected. The actual solve and rays run; altered returned Rays exercise pure/mixed reasons in the actual gate. No synthesized quality exception. Inert seams must preserve before/after files and captured ray statuses byte-for-byte.
control_scope: Known half/quarter time-offset objective targets and actual ordinary nonlinear controls
All12 pure quality and invalid-model/quality mixtures, distinct valid-but-worse behavior
Current/final/mixed/unexpected fatal cases; native full reason rosters
Original unscaled source/model delta, LSQR diagnostics, fixed weights and all-row native metadata including zero row and both epochs
Reconstruction of clamped sources and exponential model from original state at each fraction
Deferred full-device write failures, prior artifacts/dangling symlinks and malformed snapshots
Tiny homogeneous5-to6-to5 cached/fresh fields with identical physical receiver and separate native epochs
execution_authorization: Bounded invented controls only, using exact pinned compiler at unchanged production-compatible O3 flags. No real/native inverse, source adoption, full-cohort or failed-run restart.
limitations: Fixture prescribed deltas are test inputs rather than claimed solver estimates; real solve/status is captured separately.
Short component runner is not the long-running native controller; interruption must not be mistaken for terminal success.
A passed harness would not certify a global3D first arrival or physical accuracy of future inverse trials.
